title: Rare Find, free to use, no fuss, no subscription fees, simple, easy to use.
body: First impressions…Took some time to find this on the App Store but there’s finally an app that is free to download, no fuss, no adds, no subscription which is rare to find. Simple & fun, making goals realistic & achievable & satisfying once ticked off the checklist you can custom create. All is needed is a Dark mode option & extra colour choices when adding a new habit. I love being creative with customisation but less is more is also great if you don’t want anything too elaborate, this is the app for you!
